description: A utility module containing helper functions for safe division, mapping finish reasons, manipulating message and metadata structures, deep copying, and filtering exceptions and internal parameters within the litellm project.

methods.name: safe_divide_seconds
methods.description: Safely divides seconds by a denominator, returning a default if denominator is zero or negative.

methods.name: safe_divide
methods.description: Safely divides two numbers, returning a default if denominator is zero.

methods.name: map_finish_reason
methods.description: Maps various finish reason strings from different LLM providers to a standardized set.

methods.name: remove_index_from_tool_calls
methods.description: Removes 'index' keys from tool call dictionaries within message lists.

methods.name: remove_items_at_indices
methods.description: Removes items from a list in-place at specified indices.

methods.name: add_missing_spend_metadata_to_litellm_metadata
methods.description: Adds 'user_api_key' related metadata from one dict to another for spend tracking.

methods.name: get_metadata_variable_name_from_kwargs
methods.description: Determines whether to use 'metadata' or 'litellm_metadata' based on provided kwargs.

methods.name: get_litellm_metadata_from_kwargs
methods.description: Retrieves litellm-specific metadata from request kwargs, combining and filling missing info.

methods.name: _get_parent_otel_span_from_kwargs
methods.description: Extracts the parent OpenTelemetry span from request kwargs for tracing.

methods.name: process_response_headers
methods.description: Processes response headers to extract OpenAI-compatible, provider-specific, and other headers.

methods.name: preserve_upstream_non_openai_attributes
methods.description: Copies non-OpenAI attributes from an original response chunk to a model response object.

methods.name: safe_deep_copy
methods.description: Performs a safe deep copy of data, handling unpicklable objects and restoring certain metadata.

methods.name: filter_exceptions_from_params
methods.description: Recursively removes Exception objects and callables from data structures.

methods.name: filter_internal_params
methods.description: Removes internal/internal-MCP parameters from a dictionary before API requests.
